# komodo_build (Data Source)

Fetches a Komodo build by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "komodo_build" "api" {
  id = "api" # ID or display name
}

# Reference the build's canonical ID in a deployment.
resource "komodo_deployment" "api" {
  name       = "api"
  server_id  = "Local"
  image_type = "Build"
  image      = data.komodo_build.api.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Build ID or name.

### Read-Only

- `branch` (String)
- `builder_id` (String)
- `git_provider` (String)
- `image_name` (String)
- `linked_repo` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `repo` (String)
